pages.title: A Craftsperson's Reward
pages.text: Village armorer, toolsmith and weaponsmith chests may contain an Artisan Relic.
Worn: smithing templates may be retained; anvil experience costs are halved.$(br2)Hephaestus Forge: Experience storage and equipment upgrading.$(br2)Clibano: enables new alloys.
